text:
zara-docs: Opening PR to update model-catalog entry for aurora-x-lite: clarify supported context, add short migration recipe, and include SDK snippets. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/633

tom-sdk: will add Py + TS examples for cache_prefix and stream. Want both generate and stream?

maya-ml: bench gist in the PR shows p95 jump after 4096 tokens on quantized path. Recommend documenting safe max=4096 for latency-sensitive apps. gist: https://gist.github.com/maya/aurora-lite-bench-2026

eli-eng: reproduced on dedicated testbed. Runtime fell back to generic_attention for seq=8192. I'll paste sanitized logs in PR.

zara-docs: action: update CSV row, add one-paragraph migration to pin variant, include SDK snippets, link bench gist, paste log, fix lint errors reported by CI.

ops-bot: [auto] docs-lint: PR #633 failed MD013 (line length) and MD042 (code fenced language). CI: https://ci.redwood-inference.com/builds/633/logs

tom-sdk: pushed small fix for code fence languages. I'll follow up with TS versions after merge.

maya-ml: log snippet (sanitized):
```
[2026-03-23T11:05:12Z] model=aurora-x-lite kernel=fast_attention_tile status=fallback reason=tile_unsupported seq=8192
[2026-03-23T11:05:12Z] kernel=generic_attention p95=430ms
```

zara-docs: thanks. Adding product note recommending pin to aurora-xl for sustained >4k contexts with cost trade-off. Will merge after one more eng +1 and CI green.

tom-sdk: +1, looks good. I'll add helper snippet in examples repo post-merge.
